hero.heading: Built by engineers who got tired of hand-offs.
hero.lede: DivSphere started as a small delivery team frustrated by how much gets lost between the consultants who scope a project and the developers who build it. We closed that gap by keeping both under one roof.

seo.description: A Karachi-based software and IT services company built by engineers who kept consulting and delivery under one roof. Meet the team behind the work.

values.title: Own the outcome
values.body: We measure success by what changes for you after go-live, not by hours billed.

values.title: Show the work
values.body: Working software every sprint, not a status deck. You see progress before you see an invoice.

values.title: Default to secure
values.body: Security review is part of delivery, not an afterthought bolted on before launch.

values.title: Write it down
values.body: Documentation and clean handover so your team is never dependent on ours.

milestones.title: Founded as a software development studio
milestones.body: Started with a small team delivering custom web and mobile applications for regional clients.

milestones.title: Added cloud & data practice
milestones.body: Brought cloud architecture and data analytics in-house as client infrastructure needs grew past what off-the-shelf hosting could handle.

milestones.title: Launched enterprise systems & security practice
milestones.body: Formed dedicated ERP/CRM and cybersecurity teams to support larger, regulated clients.

milestones.title: Opened cross-border delivery
milestones.body: Began exporting IT and software services under applicable regional licensing, serving clients across multiple markets.

milestones.title: Full-stack technology partner
milestones.body: Seven capabilities, one delivery team, engagements ranging from single features to enterprise-wide transformation.

teamIntro.heading: Depth across the stack.
teamIntro.lede: DivSphere is organized around practice areas, not job titles — every engagement is staffed by people who've shipped that exact kind of system before.

expertise.title: Engineering leadership
expertise.body: Backgrounds in distributed systems, enterprise SaaS, and high-throughput backend architecture.

expertise.title: Applied data science
expertise.body: Practitioners who have taken ML models from notebook to production, not just research.

expertise.title: Security & compliance
expertise.body: Hands-on experience with penetration testing and regulated-industry compliance frameworks.

expertise.title: Product design
expertise.body: UX researchers and designers who work inside the same sprint as engineering, not ahead of it.

expertise.title: Program management
expertise.body: Delivery leads accountable for scope, timeline, and budget across every engagement.

expertise.title: Technology strategy
expertise.body: Former CTOs and IT directors who advise on the decisions that outlast any one project.
